## Highlights

- **Native Ubuntu 26.04 (resolute) packages (`amd64`, `arm64`)**: built natively
  on Ubuntu 26.04 and linked against the system `libllhttp` library. Hosts on
  Ubuntu 26.04 that previously installed the `1.6.0` release (Ubuntu 24.04
  package) upgrade cleanly to `1.6.0-3~ubuntu26.04.1`.
- **Official Debian `1.6.0-3` source**: all Debian 13, Ubuntu 24.04, and Ubuntu
  26.04 packages are now built directly from Debian's official `ocserv 1.6.0-3`
  source package instead of the earlier local `1.6.0-0local1` import, picking up
  Debian's refreshed `1.6.0` packaging, patches, and `ocserv.conf` comments.

Upgrading keeps a modified `/etc/ocserv/ocserv.conf` and does not restart a
running `ocserv.service`; run `sudo systemctl restart ocserv` when you are
ready to switch to the updated binary.
